div.head: I Cn 21
div.ab: ⁊ ealle Cristene men we lǽrað swiðe georne, þæt hí inweardre heortan æfre God lufian ⁊ rihtne Cristendóm geornlice healdan ⁊ godcundan lareowan geornlice hyran ⁊ Godes lara ⁊ laga smeagan ⁊ spyrian oft ⁊ gelòme, heom sylfum to ðearfe.

And very zealously we enjoin upon all Christian men that ever, from their inmost hearts, they love God and zealously uphold the true Christian faith, and eagerly obey their spiritual teachers, and frequently and often ponder over and inquire into the precepts and laws of God for their own advantage.

And ealle Cristene men we lærað swiðe georne, þæt híg inweardre heortan æfre God lufian ⁊ rihtne Cristendom geornlice healdan ⁊ godcundan lareowan geornlice hyran ⁊ Godes lara ⁊ laga smeagan [⁊ spyrian] [B, A] oft ⁊ gelome, him sylfum to þearfe.
